intro: The Point is a small waterfront pocket of Rough Hollow, and the homes there look out over Lake Travis from the water's edge. CleanzATX cleans these windows with pure water and poles, so nothing touches the house.

paragraphs: The Point is a short run of waterfront homesites on Lake Travis, and it is often named as the most sought after address in Rough Hollow. Prices start around $2M. It is not gated, which makes access simple. The section is small, so you are looking at a handful of custom homes rather than a long street of similar plans.
With homesites on the water, the main glass generally faces the lake. Expect larger windows and sliders on the water side, and we plan the visit around that elevation.

sections.h2: What The Point windows deal with
paragraphs: Wet air and open water make this the spottiest section for glass. Every breeze off the lake carries mist, and wind on the open water adds more. Water that dries on a pane leaves hard water spots, and a few seasons of that leaves a haze. Afternoon sun hits the west side and shows each streak.

Pollen is another factor. Cedar pollen runs December to February and live oak pollen from March to April, and both coat the screens and tracks. We clean screens at $5 each and tracks at $5, and hard water removal is $10 a pane for anything stubborn.

Because the section is small, we usually pair it with a visit in nearby Waters Edge or Lakeside on the same morning, which keeps travel low. Rough Hollow HOA rules and a sub association both apply, so we keep equipment off the street and do not block driveways. Soft wash is the right choice for stucco and any limestone here.

A 5,000 sq ft waterfront home is about $500 for exterior windows, and the visit takes around four hours. Inside and out is $15 a window. Text for a quote and you will usually hear back inside the hour.

faq.q: Why do my lake windows get spotty so fast?
faq.a: Mist from the lake and sprinkler spray land on the glass and dry, leaving minerals. Hard water here is the cause. Regular cleaning with near 0 TDS water keeps the spots from baking in.
No, it is not gated, so we simply drive in at the scheduled time. Please make sure pets are inside and any side gates on your property are unlocked.

faq.q: Can you clean second floor lake windows without a ladder?
faq.a: Yes. Our poles stretch to three stories while we stand on the ground, which covers most waterfront designs in Rough Hollow.

faq.q: Do you also wash stucco and limestone here?
faq.a: Yes. We soft wash stucco and limestone with a 12V system, never a pressure wash, which protects the finish. Prices start at $0.20 per sq ft with a $400 minimum.

faq.q: Do you work around docks and lake equipment?
faq.a: We stay on the house side and keep hoses and poles clear of walkways and anything near the water. If you have items on the patio, tell us ahead of time and we will work around them.
